sheet.about.heading: About this map
sheet.about.body: A hand-made model of India: terrain from open elevation data, official state boundaries, in English and Hindi. Drag to pan, pinch to zoom, twist to turn, drag with two fingers to tilt.
sheet.next: Tap a state to lift it out of the map; tap a peg, a bead or a figurine for its card. The contents lists the atlas's pages, the key on the map says what is drawn, and the menu holds every layer. The play button tours the places on show; the compass turns the view back to north.
